name: cc-kit-harness
description: Test harness for the shared mod kit (templates/mods/cc-kit.ts): one probe module registering a suggestion, run by claude plugin test. Not a marketplace plugin.

probe_turn_end.title: Probe turn-end key
probe_turn_end.description: Gives the probe an atTurnEnd callback (suggests <cwd>/PROBE.md when it exists). Off by default so the harness can also exercise a suggestion with no atTurnEnd.

probe_tool_key.title: Probe tool-call key
probe_tool_key.description: Gives the probe a Write-matched onToolCall (suggests a written .md file). On by default; off leaves the suggestion with no tool.call hook.

probe_board.title: Probe board hook
probe_board.description: Registers the probe's own unmatched tool.call hook beside the suggestion's matched one, as a module hosting a board does. Off by default.
